LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin.label: Suiyin
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin.description: Suiyin's trust in your colony changes with how you treat ratkin. Her incidents follow a largely random rhythm.\n\nTrust ranges from -100 to 100. The selection weight for major threats is multiplied by 1 - trust / 400, and their maximum interval is divided by the same factor. At -100, 0, and 100 trust, this factor is 1.25, 1, and 0.75 respectively. Higher trust makes major threats less likely to be selected and lengthens their maximum interval.
